records.notes: Visible forms show تَعۡقِلُونَ in Hafs/Warsh/Qalun and يَعۡقِلُونَ in Shu'bah/Bazzi/Duri/Qunbul/Susi.
Visible forms show تَقُولُواْ in Hafs/Shu'bah/Warsh/Qalun/Bazzi/Qunbul and يَقُولُواْ in Duri/Susi; the ending-mark differences are secondary.
Visible forms show تَقُولُوٓاْ or its ending-mark variants in most editions and يَقُولُوٓاْ in Duri/Susi, a clear initial-letter difference.
The visible lexical form is consistent; differences are dagger-alif presentation in Warsh/Qalun and pronoun-mark presentation in Bazzi/Qunbul.
Visible forms show وَيَذَرُهُمۡ in Hafs/Shu'bah/Duri/Susi and وَنَذَرُهُمۡ in Warsh/Qalun/Bazzi/Qunbul, with clear initial-letter differences.
